statement: For every specified connected countable actual CW classifying space B of dimension at most two with nontrivial perfect group H, construct an actual inclusion B->X into an aspherical two-dimensional CW complex with at most continuum many cells, inducing H->G injective and all ordinary integral homology isomorphisms, with G normally generated by H. The group G and every quotient of G solve every one-variable equation of total variable exponent +1 or -1. The group G has no nontrivial countable quotient which is mixed-identity-free, torsion-free with exactly two conjugacy classes, or nonabelian uniformly simple. There is in particular an actual two-dimensional acyclic map BG->S^2 with |G|<=continuum, no images in torsion or locally linear groups, and the same three quotient exclusions, extending the original A.10 map literally.

notes: Enumerates epimorphisms from countable subgroups of each current stage, not only maps from the whole group; coefficients lift from that subgroup while the geometric block is attached over the whole torsion-free stage. This keeps each pass at size continuum. Omega_1 passes capture a countable preimage-generating subgroup of every final countable quotient in the listed classes. One-variable unimodular adjunctions are interleaved and retain actual dimension, homology and normal generation; every quotient inherits the resulting equation-solving property by coefficient lifting. The conclusion is precisely absence of epimorphisms onto the listed classes; it does not claim those properties pass to arbitrary target subgroups or that all countable images vanish. The finite-normal-generation argument gives a further necessary condition: any remaining nontrivial countable quotient has an infinite simple quotient satisfying a mixed identity and failing uniform simplicity. Direct Higman-generator arguments exclude torsion and locally linear images; the characteristic-zero linear proof uses a finite nilpotent logarithm and unipotent conjugation, without importing residual finiteness of linear groups. D independently audited the complete main construction and the added matrix proof; A independently audited the final equation closure, torsion and linear refinements. Both audits passed without correction.
